anchor_goal: Resolve unexpected billing charge on customer monthly subscription invoice

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: I noticed an unexpected $29 charge on my monthly subscription invoice this morning.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, thank you for reaching out. Let me pull up your billing records and inspect that $29 transaction.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: My account ID is ACCT-8921. I only subscribed to the standard $15 tier.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. I see what happened: an automatic add-on for team collaboration was activated last week.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: I never authorized that collaboration add-on. Can we please cancel it and issue a refund?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I have removed the add-on from your plan and processed an immediate refund of $29 back to your original payment method.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Thank you very much. When should I expect the refund credit to appear on my card statement?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Your bank should reflect the refund within 3 to 5 business days. You will also receive an email confirmation shortly.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Everything is clear and sorted out. Thanks for the prompt resolution!

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: You are very welcome! Have a wonderful day.
